## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Eva Altmann [20. Dezember 1938], SZ-AAL/B1.1
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.1
- Datum: 20.12.1938
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
French Line

à bord, le 20. XII. 38

Jan
9 - Philadelphia, Pa.
11 - Boston, Mass.
12 - New York
14 - Indianapolis
15 - Chicago, Ill.
18 - Detroit, Mich.
19 - Cincinnati, Ohio
21 - Toledo, Ohio - Miss[?]
23 - Kansas City, Mo.
26 - Houston, Texas ~~[...3...]?~~
February
1 - San Antonio, Texas
2 - Dallas, Texas
9 - San Francisco, California
13 - Salt Lake City, Utah
24 - Los Angeles, California
27 - Brooklyn, New York
Toronto, Ont. (Canada)

Dear Eva,
This is the list as far as we know it.
We shall arrive Thursday morning. The ship is
beautiful, and after a day in bed I feel quite
all-right. It is warm outside and you can walk on
the promenade deck without a coat. In the afternoon
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Briefpapier der 'French Line'. Flecken durch Feuchtigkeitseinwirkung. Die Zeile 'Toronto, Ont. (Canada)' ist leicht eingerückt unter der Liste.

pages.transcription:
there is always a Punch and Judy show and
later on a picture. I am sure you would
like it especially as there are a few dogs
on board which sometimes come to the public
rooms and then, you get wine for your meals
as much as you like, there is a bottle of red
and of white wine on each table in the dining-
room.

Wednesday.
Now we are nearly there, and to-morrow
morning we shall arrive in New York. You can
imagine how I am looking forward to it.
From the list you see that I am staying in
New York for a fortnight. Then the ~~trae~~
travelling starts again and you will receive
a postcard at least from each place. But you
must not forget to answer my letters!

Best love to all
auntie Lotte
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brieftext, Fortsetzung von Seite 1. Flecken durch Feuchtigkeitseinwirkung.
